findings.claim: The switch's onCheckedChange always dispatches setOverride even when the new value equals the config value, so toggling a row off and back on leaves it marked as an override (shown as matching the current chain) instead of returning to a clean, non-overridden state, causing users to accumulate silent overrides.

When the new switch value equals row.configValue, clearOverride(feature) should be dispatched instead of setOverride, matching the behavior of the revert-override control, and the corresponding test file should be updated to cover this case.

The editor's rows show the raw config-service value in configValue and chainScope while useHasFeature and everything gated by it reflect the overridden value, so the 'Config service' column does not reflect overrides even though the switch below it does; this intentional split is not documented.
A doc comment on useFeatureFlagEditorData explaining that its data is deliberately un-overridden would clarify the design intent.

The tooltip trigger uses visibility: hidden with an aria-label, but visibility: hidden removes the element from the accessibility tree as well as from hit-testing, so the aria-label and tooltip content are never announced to screen reader users even when matchesCurrentChain is true.
Either sr-only text alongside the visible check should be used for reliable accessibility, or the aria-label on the icon should be dropped since the TooltipContent already carries the announcement.

The featureFlagOverridesSlice reducer is registered unconditionally and included in persistedSlices and broadcastState, so the reducer, persisted state, and broadcast channel ship in production even though applyFeatureOverrides is a no-op there.
A stale featureFlagOverrides localStorage entry, for example left over from prior staging use on the same origin, will silently persist in production forever with no UI to clear it.

The marker string "local feature-flag overrides" used in the bundle exclusion test is generic enough that an unrelated future copy change could accidentally satisfy or invalidate the test, so a more distinctive, editor-only sentinel string or a dedicated data attribute should be used instead.
There is no unit test for FeatureFlagEditor covering the search filter, the 'Reset all overrides' button's enable/disable state and dispatch, and the empty overridden section.
There is no unit test for FeatureFlagSection verifying it returns null when rows.length is 0.
There is no test verifying that applyFeatureOverrides correctly handles a chain with an override for a feature not present in the Chain['features'] enum type, even though the cast to string is safe.
The alignment spacer is a bit magic and, despite an existing comment on the grid, could get lost or become confusing in future edits.
Sorting is done inline via localeCompare on every render even though FEATURES is a fixed enum, so alphabetizing once at module scope would avoid redundant re-sorting.

selectOverrideCount subscribes the sidebar to the store in production even though the feature flag group is hidden there; hoisting the IS_PRODUCTION check above useAppSelector would avoid this, though it requires a conditional-hook pattern and the current cost is negligible.
